Context: 5. Benefits on Retirement

## 5. Benefits on Retirement  
8. Retirement on superannuation.On superannuation he shall be entitled to benefits as admissible under the Pension Fund Regulatory and  
Development Authority (Exits and Withdrawals under National Pension System) Regulations, 2015. - Rule 11.  
9. Retirement on completion of twenty years' regular service.On completion of 20 years service, he may retire by giving notice of not less than three months in writing to the Appointing Authority.
